'''Plasma probes''' were military drones utilized by pyrotechnic specialists during the time of wars between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. A small levitating probe was deployed in battle to incinerate a designated location and keep the enemy troops out of it. The probes were equipped with a multi-nozzle [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrower]] putting on fire everything around the drone.<ref name="plasma probe">{{TORcite|type=other|Ability: "Plasma Probe"}}</ref>
